_comment: Body-centric keypoint model of the MABe22 mouse triplets, with vision of the arena walls, trained only on the pose-only MABe22 files (mouse_triplet_train.npy and mouse_triplet_test.npy), which have no videos, with a d_model of 256 instead of 2048.  The same as config_mouse_llm_bodycentric_wallvision_20261116.json but for those, and its bin edges, from the pose-only data.  Settings not here are in mousellm/config_mouse_llm_default.json.
_comment_datadir: made by python -m mousellm.convert_mabe22, which splits only the pose-only files, and estimates each sequence's arena from all of them
_comment_bin_edges_absolute: from optimal binning of the train split, runs/2026-11-16-mouse-binning-pose-only-dmodel-256/mousellm_binning_clm_all_20261117T004645 (LSF job 155422006)
_comment_d_model: embedding dimension, smaller than the default 2048
_comment_niterplot: no debug plots during training, which slow it down
_comment_obs_embedding: wall vision is embedded as the other mice's vision is
